successors.name: French Africa
successors.text: the island, annexed by France as a colony in 1897 ('French Madagascar')

ledger.x: c. 1540: Andriamanelo is traditionally credited with founding Imerina on the central highlands. 'who is traditionally credited with founding Imerina in 1540.' The page gives no extent; the circle round Antananarivo is the researcher's reading of the capitals it names.

c. 1796: the southern Betsileo country. Cliopatria's shape grows by 69 cells to the south; the page names the Betsileo among the territories absorbed under Andrianampoinimerina and dates only 'from around 1800' his effort to unite the island's ethnic groups, so the year is the shape's (page silent).

c. 1803: the Sihanaka and Bezanozano country. Cliopatria's shape grows by 107 cells to the east; the page names the Sihanaka and the Bezanozano among the absorbed territories without a year (page silent).
1811: land lost to rebels at Radama's accession.
23 October 1817: the Anglo-Merina treaty recognises Radama as 'King of Madagascar'.
1824: posts at Vohemar and Diego Suarez.
1825: posts at Farafangana and Fort Dauphin.
17 December 1885: Antsiranana is ceded to France.
1896: the kingdom becomes the Malagasy Protectorate.

wars.name: Andrianampoinimerina's reunification of Imerina
wars.outcome: Antananarivo conquered in 1793; 'By 1795 he had gained the allegiance and submission of all the territories' of Imerina.

wars.name: Radama I's campaigns of expansion
wars.outcome: Toamasina 1817; Menabe 1820-1822; the north-east coast 1823; posts at Vohemar, Diego Suarez and Mahajanga 1824 and at Farafangana and Fort Dauphin 1825; the Antalaotra defeated 1826; the Antesaka 1827; 'All together, Radama united two thirds of the island…

wars.name: French attack on Foulpointe and Ivondro
wars.outcome: A fleet of six French ships attacked the fort of Foulpointe and Ivondro on the east coast in 1829 and was repelled by the Merina army, retiring to Île Sainte-Marie.

wars.name: First Franco-Hova War
wars.outcome: Treaty of Tamatave, 17 December 1885: Antsiranana ceded, French control of foreign policy, indemnity; no formal protectorate.

wars.name: Second Franco-Hova War
wars.outcome: French victory: Toamasina 12 December 1894, Antananarivo entered on 1 October 1895; protectorate 1896, monarchy ended 1897.
